text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains above 2%, with Ethereum slightly outpacing Bitcoin—a sign that altseason interest is beginning to stir despite Bitcoin's dominant 59.6% market share. The Fear & Greed index at 63 (Greed) and rising suggests participants are moving past caution, though 24-hour volume of $84B indicates activity remains measured rather than euphoric. Broader altcoins like Solana and BNB are tracking the rally without breaking out, pointing to a cautiously optimistic mood where risk appetite is returning but confidence remains conditional.
